\textbf{Justify your answers and show your work.}

\emph{Evaluate each algebraic expression for the given value of the
variable.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $4-2(3+x)^{2},\mbox{ for \ensuremath{x=-5}}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $\frac{2x+y}{xy-2x}$, for $x=1$ and $y=-4$\vspace{1.5in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Simplify the algebraic expression. Write all exponents as positive. }
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $7-6[-\frac{1}{2}(6-2)+1]$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $\frac{5}{(7-12)^{2}}+\frac{1+3}{5}$\vspace{2.0in}
\item $-\left(\frac{4}{y}\right)^{2}$\vspace{1.0in}
\item $(4x^{2})^{\nicefrac{1}{2}}$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $(x^{3}x^{2})^{-2}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $(-2x^{3}y)(-6x^{6}y^{10})$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $\frac{6xy^{3}}{18x^{2}y^{-5}}$\vspace{2.25in}
\item $\sqrt{\frac{1}{25}}$\vspace{1.0in}
\end{enumerate}
\newpage{}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $5\sqrt{12}-3\sqrt{3}$\vspace{1.0in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Perform the indicated operation and simplify.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $(x^{5}-8x^{2}+5x)-(-2x^{5}+x^{2}+12)$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $(2x^{2}y-2xy)+(3x^{2}y-xy)$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $(6x-2)(x^{2}+x-3)$\vspace{2.0in}
\item $(5x+3y)^{2}$\vspace{1.5in}\newpage{}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Factor Completely.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $x^{2}+3x-10$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $3x^{3}-6x^{2}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $3x^{3}+9x^{2}-30x$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $16y^{2}-25$\vspace{1.25in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Factor by grouping.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $x^{3}-3x^{2}+4x-12$.
\end{enumerate}
